faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How to prepare for the procedure and what care is needed afterward?
faq.answer1: Preparation and aftercare depend on the procedure: laser hair removal, electrolysis, waxing and sugaring.
faq.answer2: Contraindications depend on the procedure: laser hair removal, electrolysis, waxing and sugaring. Before the first procedure, the specialist will hold a consultation and check for contraindications.
faq.question3: What to choose: electroepilation or laser hair removal?
faq.answer3:
Our specialists will help you choose the best hair removal method that suits your skin type, hair color, and the area you want to treat.

Laser Hair Removal:
✔ Suitable for dark hair and fair skin (modern lasers can also work on darker skin, but there are still some limitations).
✔ The procedure is fast, especially for large areas.
✔ Less painful compared to electroepilation.

Electroepilation:
✔ Treats each follicle individually, and a lasting result comes from a course of sessions.
✔ Suitable for all hair types (even light and gray hair).
✔ Can be performed on all skin phototypes.
faq.question4: At what age can hair removal/depilation be done?
faq.answer4:
Laser Hair Removal: Officially allowed from the age of 18. In some cases, the procedure can be performed earlier, but only with written parental or guardian consent.

Sugaring and Wax Depilation: Regular procedures can start from the age of 12-14. If unwanted hair appears early and causes psychological discomfort, the procedure can be done earlier, with parental consent.
faq.answer5: The studio has two laser devices. The DEKA Motus AX alexandrite laser uses dynamic in-motion (Moveo) hair removal. The Alvi Prague DL-7000 diode laser, 2024 model, has a cooling system for comfort during the procedure and a short pulse – 20 joules in 25 ms. The specialist will choose the device during the consultation based on your skin type and hair colour. Prices for both devices are in the price list, and you can read more about choosing a laser on the laser hair removal page.
faq.question6: Does laser hair removal remove ingrown hairs?
faq.answer6: Laser hair removal can help reduce the number of ingrown hairs, as it affects the hair follicle, destroying it and decreasing the likelihood of hair growing inward in the future.

laser.title: Laser hair removal in Lviv
laser.intro: Laser hair removal at MS STUDIO LASER is done on two modern devices: the DEKA Motus AX alexandrite laser and the Alvi Prague DL-7000 diode laser. The specialist chooses the laser and settings for your skin type, hair colour and area, so the procedure is comfortable and the result lasts.
contraindications: Cellulite treatment in the treated area
Very dark or tanned skin (no solarium for at least 2 weeks)
Active herpes in the treated area
Chronic skin diseases: psoriasis, eczema, lupus
preparation: Shave the area thoroughly 2–6 hours before the procedure
Do not wax, sugar or tweeze for 3–4 weeks before the procedure
No tanning or solarium for 2 weeks before and after the procedure
No antibiotics (tetracyclines, sulfonamides, fluoroquinolones) for 2 weeks before the procedure
Do not take retinoids or use acne creams containing retinoids on the treated area
Do not use alcohol-based deodorants or antiperspirants for 24 hours before the procedure
aftercare: For 3–4 days apply panthenol-based products to soothe and heal the skin
Avoid scrubs and peels for 3–4 days
For 3 days avoid the gym, pool, sauna and heavy physical activity
Avoid direct sunlight and solarium for 2 weeks
Protect treated areas with SPF 50+ sunscreen when going outside
Keep the skin clean and away from dirt and germs
Do not take hot baths on the day of the procedure
For 2 days do not apply alcohol-based deodorants, toners or other cosmetics

alexandrite.title: DEKA Motus AX alexandrite laser hair removal in Lviv
alexandrite.lead: Smooth skin and a comfortable procedure with Moveo technology, for women and men.
alexandrite.intro: Less daily shaving, more freedom in how you care for yourself. At MS STUDIO LASER in Lviv we perform alexandrite laser hair removal on the Italian DEKA Motus AX device with Moveo technology. It combines a 755 nm wavelength, gradual energy delivery and contact skin cooling to remove unwanted hair effectively.

sections.title: Moveo: alexandrite hair removal over gel
paragraphs: The key feature of Moveo is smooth work in motion. The specialist applies a clear gel and treats the area with repeated passes of a cooled sapphire handpiece.
Energy builds up gradually, heating the structures of the hair follicle, while cooling helps protect the skin surface and reduce discomfort.
You may feel warmth or tingling during the procedure. How strong it is depends on the area, hair density and your individual sensitivity.

sections.title: How the DEKA Motus AX works and what results to expect
paragraphs: An alexandrite laser emits light that is absorbed by melanin, the pigment in hair. The light energy turns into heat and damages the follicle structures responsible for hair growth.
The goal of the course is to significantly reduce unwanted hair and keep the skin smooth for a long time. Treated hairs fall out gradually over the following days and weeks.

A clear result takes a course of procedures, because hair is at different stages of growth. We choose the number of sessions and the intervals individually. Maintenance procedures can follow if needed.

electro.title: Electrolysis in Lviv for women and men
electro.lead: Permanent removal of unwanted hair, whatever its colour.
electro.intro: At MS STUDIO LASER in Lviv we perform electrolysis for women and men on HEBE and FLASH devices. The method permanently removes dark, brown, light, red and grey hair on the face and body. Single hairs or a full area: we will help you work out the scope and plan your course.

sections.title: How electrolysis works
paragraphs: The specialist inserts a fine needle electrode into the natural channel of the hair follicle and delivers an electrical pulse. It destroys the cells responsible for hair growth, and the hair is then gently removed with tweezers.
A fully destroyed follicle no longer produces hair. This takes precise insertion, correctly chosen settings and consistent work throughout the course.
Unlike laser hair removal, electrolysis does not need dark pigment in the hair. That is why it is also chosen for light, white, grey and red hair.

sections.title: Our HEBE and FLASH devices
paragraphs: HEBE is equipment from a Polish brand for needle electrolysis. Individual settings make it possible to adapt the parameters to your hair and the treated area.
FLASH is a Ukrainian-made device with thermolysis and flash thermolysis modes. Adjustable power and pulse duration help the specialist choose the effect for each follicle.
We use sterile disposable needle electrodes. The specialist controls the treatment of every hair and takes your individual sensitivity into account.

sections.title: Electrolysis for women: face and body
paragraphs: Our studio removes hair on the upper lip, chin, cheeks and other agreed areas of the face.
We also treat the underarms, deep bikini, arms, legs, stomach, chest and back. The method suits both whole areas and single hairs, including those left after laser hair removal.

sections.title: Electrolysis for men in Lviv
paragraphs: Men can have electrolysis on the face and body: back, shoulders, chest, stomach, underarms, arms, legs and intimate areas, including deep bikini.
You can choose removal of single hairs, correction of an agreed area or gradual clearing of an area. We build the plan around hair density and structure, the size of the area and the result you want.

sections.title: How many procedures it takes
paragraphs: Electrolysis treats each follicle separately. Hair grows in cycles, so one visit is not enough to fully clear an area.
The number and length of sessions depend on the area, hair density, previous hair removal methods and your individual growth patterns. Some follicles may need repeat treatment.
At the consultation we discuss your expectations and an initial plan, then adjust it according to your results.

sections.title: Four-hands electrolysis
paragraphs: At MS STUDIO LASER you can book two specialists working at the same time. They treat agreed areas in parallel, which shortens the visit.
We will tell you when you book whether this format suits your areas.

faq.q: How much does electrolysis cost in Lviv?
faq.a: You pay for the specialist's time: from {{min}} ₴ per minute. You can also book two specialists working at once to make the session shorter.

faq.q: What hair does electrolysis remove?
faq.a: Electrolysis works on hair of any colour: blonde, black, grey, light brown or red, because unlike laser it does not depend on the pigment in the hair. Every hair is treated individually, so it suits the face, bikini line and other areas.

faq.q: Why do I need a course rather than one session?
faq.a: Hair grows in cycles: at any moment hairs in the skin are at different stages, and some have not reached the surface yet. That is why everything cannot be treated at once. Some follicles also need repeat treatment before the hair stops growing.

faq.q: How long does an electrolysis course take?
faq.a: Usually from a few months to a year and a half, sometimes longer. It depends on the area, hair density and whether the hair was previously removed by waxing, sugaring or tweezing. The specialist sets the number of sessions and the intervals at the consultation.

faq.q: What affects the result of electrolysis?
faq.a: Precise treatment of the follicle, the hair growth stage, hair density and thickness, hormones, regular sessions and aftercare. Hormonal changes can bring new hair later on, which is then treated separately.

faq.q: How do I prepare for electrolysis?
faq.a: Let the hair grow to 4–6 mm — 7–10 days after shaving or 3–4 weeks after waxing. Do a gentle peel 3 days before and avoid tanning for 7 days before the session.

faq.q: What should I do after electrolysis?
faq.a: Slight redness and swelling are normal. Do not wet the skin for 12 hours, moisturise the area for 3–4 days and avoid tanning for 14 days.

sugaring.title: Sugaring in Lviv for women and men
sugaring.lead: Smooth skin for several weeks without daily shaving.
sugaring.intro: At MS STUDIO LASER in Lviv we offer sugaring for women and men: removing unwanted hair from the root with sugar paste. One area or several in a single visit: choose what suits you, and we will take care of a thorough procedure and your comfort.

sections.title: How sugaring works
paragraphs: The specialist applies sugar paste against hair growth and removes it in the direction of growth. The paste grips the hairs and removes them from the root, so the skin stays smooth longer than after shaving.
The density of the paste and the technique are chosen for the area, hair structure and skin condition. Any paste left over rinses off easily with water.
The method suits hair of any colour: dark, brown, light, red and grey.

sections.title: What results sugaring gives
paragraphs: You feel the smoothness right after the procedure. The result usually lasts about three weeks, but this depends on the area, how fast your hair grows and previous hair removal methods.
People choose sugaring when they want to reach for the razor less often and enjoy smooth skin for longer.

faq.q: What is the difference between sugaring and waxing?
faq.a: Sugaring uses sugar paste applied against hair growth and removed with it. Wax is great for treating large areas quickly. Both remove hair from the root.

faq.q: How long after shaving should I wait?

faq.q: How do I prepare for sugaring?
faq.a: Shower 24 hours before without shower creams, soap or other oily products. The best time is the first 5 days after your period. Skip deodorant for 24 hours before underarm sugaring.

waxing.intro: At MS STUDIO LASER in Lviv we offer face and body waxing for women and men. Hair is removed from the root, so the skin stays smooth longer than after using a razor. Choose one area or several in a single visit: we will take care of thorough work and your comfort.

sections.title: How waxing works
paragraphs: The specialist applies prepared wax to the chosen area and removes it together with the hairs. The material and technique are chosen for the area, hair density and your skin.
The method removes hair of any colour: dark, brown, light, red and grey.

sections.title: Professional materials and a technologist's experience
paragraphs: Our studio is an official Italwax representative, and its founder Maria is a technologist for the brand.
Knowing the materials and techniques helps us choose wax for different areas and hair structures. We pay attention to the temperature of the material, correct application and precise removal.
How the procedure feels is individual and depends on the area and your skin sensitivity.

sections.title: What results the procedure gives
paragraphs: You feel the smoothness right after waxing, and it lasts for several weeks. How long depends on the area, how fast your hair grows and previous hair removal methods.
Waxing is a convenient choice for anyone who wants to shave less often and enjoy smooth skin for longer.

endosphere.title: Endosphere therapy in Lviv
endosphere.intro: Endosphere therapy is a body and face treatment based on compressive micro-vibration. A rotating cylinder with spheres gently works on the tissues, which is why it is chosen for body contouring, reducing cellulite, improving skin tone and lymphatic drainage.
endosphere.howItWorks: A course of 6 to 12 sessions gives the best and lasting result. The specialist will choose the areas and number of sessions for you.

faq.q: How much does endosphere therapy cost in Lviv?
faq.a: From {{min}} ₴ per session depending on the area. See course prices on the prices page.

faq.q: Is endosphere therapy painful?
faq.a: No, it feels pleasant. The device power is adjusted individually for you.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need for a lasting effect?
faq.a: We recommend a course of 6 to 12 sessions. Lighter legs and drained fluid are noticeable after the first session, and after the course — fewer centimetres, firmer skin and a smoother contour.

faq.q: Who is endosphere therapy for?
faq.a: For swelling (especially in the morning), cellulite or loss of skin firmness; for those who eat little but don't lose weight; and for recovery after workouts.

faq.q: How long does a session take?
faq.a: From 30 to 60 minutes depending on the area.
